name: wikicraft
description: Local-first markdown wiki, SQLite FTS5 search, ADR studio, and GitHub Wiki sync.

tools.name: wiki_status
tools.description: Report wikicraft status, page counts, ADR counts, and health

tools.name: wiki_page_save
tools.description: Create or update a wiki documentation page

tools.name: wiki_page_get
tools.description: Retrieve a wiki page by ID with backlinks and outgoing links

tools.name: wiki_page_delete
tools.description: Delete a documentation page by ID

tools.name: wiki_page_search
tools.description: Full-text search (SQLite FTS5) across documentation pages

tools.name: wiki_page_backlinks
tools.description: Find all pages that link to the given page ID

tools.name: wiki_adr_save
tools.description: Create or update an Architecture Decision Record (ADR)

tools.name: wiki_adr_get
tools.description: Get details of an Architecture Decision Record (ADR)

tools.name: wiki_tree_import
tools.description: Recursively import a directory of Markdown documentation files into the wiki

tools.name: wiki_seed_demo
tools.description: Seed the wiki with sample architecture documentation, cross-links, and ADRs

tools.name: wiki_gh_pull
tools.description: Clone or pull a GitHub repository wiki and ingest all markdown pages into the SQLite index

tools.name: wiki_gh_push
tools.description: Export all wiki pages and ADRs to a GitHub Wiki repository, generate _Sidebar.md navigation, and push via git

tools.name: wiki_gh_status
tools.description: Check local clone state and remote commit information for a GitHub Wiki repository

tools.name: wiki_site_export
tools.description: Export the wiki documentation and ADRs to a standalone static HTML website ready for GitHub Pages or offline browsing

tools.name: wiki_inbox_drain
tools.description: Acknowledge and clear pending inbound signals in the wikicraft inbox
